item.title: Distributed, high-performance blob storage on SQLite
item.description:

item.title: 15M web servers on one VM – smoltcp, DPDK, AF_XDP
item.description:
📝 We’re using port=0, so the kernel picks an available port from ip_local_port_range. Ports 1024-32768 are skipped to keep dynamically allocated ports from conflicting with existing apps. Let’s simply connect 15M/32k=450 new network cards to the server.
🔗 Read more: https://kapteko.com/15-million-webservers/

item.title: SSD prices will start going down the second half of next year
item.description:
📝 Hard drives will take longer, probably into 2028, because the factories that make them have already sold that output. SSDs should turn first. Hard drives are booked up.
🔗 Read more: https://www.drivevault.io/blog/when-will-hard-drive-prices-come-down.html

item.title: Do not buy RAM, compress
item.description:
📝 Memory compression is not new. Unfortunately not all Linux environments have RAM compression enabled by default. Compressing memory does not come with downsides.
🔗 Read more: https://curiousbits.nl/blog/do-not-buy-ram-compress/

item.title: DeepMind Employees Are Unionising
item.description:
📝 Google Erased Its Own Ban on AI for Weapons and SurveillanceWeeks into Trump's second term, Google quietly deleted its 2018 pledge never to build AI weapons or rights-violating surveillance, made after staff protests over a military drone contract. It wasn't framed as a reversal: the sole edit note read, 'We've made updates to our AI Principles. ' WIRED · February 2025 ↗.
🔗 Read more: https://www.gdmunion.co.uk
